name: 笑傲江湖4公开版
group_note: 笑傲江湖Ⅳ ("Xiao Ao Jiang Hu IV", public release), in-game branded 「夕阳再现」, a fourth-generation fork built on a 炎龙 (Yanlong) codebase core. Boots and completes registration cleanly under WASM with zero compile or runtime errors -- no LPC bugs found anywhere. Only action taken: seeded fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (two (boss)-tier founder accounts -- afei/tianya -- already present; wiz_levels tops out at (ceo) > (boss) > (admin), but (admin) already grants full '/' write access per trusted_write, matching the convention used across this pass; SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd, a commented-out '// #define SECURITY_D "/adm/daemons/securd"' decoy note exists in globals.h but is inactive). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> a separate '身份标识' (identity token, used for suicide/password-recovery) + confirm -> gift-stat selection (0 for random, y to accept) -> email (requires id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet including a custom mapper-protocol tag stream ('lbadd0'/'lbclear0' etc, harmless client-side markup, not an error), zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via the in-game banner '★ 您目前的权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 16167 .lpc files (16133 written, 4 errors, 30 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 4 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
